name: mcp-mobile-phone-waterfall-orchestrator
description: MCP server for Mobile Phone Waterfall. Find mobile phone numbers by chaining your own Prospeo, Lusha, ContactOut, and FullEnrich keys: one row per contact with the number, line type, country, Do Not Call flag, and the provider credits used. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.

apify_token.title: Apify API Token
apify_token.description: Apify API token for running the actor

prospeo_api_key.title: Prospeo API Key
prospeo_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Prospeo key. The actor skips this provider without it.

lusha_api_key.title: Lusha API Key
lusha_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Lusha key. The actor skips this provider without it.

contactout_api_key.title: Contactout API Key
contactout_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Contactout key. The actor skips this provider without it.

fullenrich_api_key.title: Fullenrich API Key
fullenrich_api_key.description: Optional. Your own Fullenrich key. The actor skips this provider without it.
